A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the card-type or stat bar, the game-text box and the numbers beside it) with the corrected game text, and below it a black strip with the title and a white E, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 January 2013.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-L-derekhobbieklivian-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian]] (Decipher, 1996; Decipher's [[Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes to Decipher's errata wording, the same words as [[Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's November 1998 errata]]: “Power +2 when at same site as Biggs. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots (3 if a Star Destroyer is at same location). When piloting Rogue 4, also adds 2 to maneuver.”. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Derek ‘Hobbie’ Klivian” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
